hooks.description: Block git add of .env/.dev.vars/keys/credentials, forced adds, and commit -a while a secret is tracked
Block drizzle-kit push and destructive SQL against production databases, and drizzle-kit drop
Compare vitest coverage output with tdd.coverageThreshold from pipeline.config.json
After drizzle-kit generate, remind to run the destructive-DDL check; after drizzle-kit push, remind that push is dev-only
After all vitest tests pass, remind to run check-types, security-scan, and the coverage threshold
